title: データサイエンス入門
subtitle: Introduction to Data Science
courseType:
Practical Engineering Education Program
Practical Engineering Education Courses
educationalGoal: Learn the basics of data handling. In this course, you will learn the basic operations of the spreadsheet software Excel, which is an introductory tool for handling data. Then, using Excel, you will learn data handling skills such as aggregation and analysis of experimental data and questionnaire data. In addition, we will visualize actual datasets from the real world using Excel, and thereby gain an understanding of the meaning of the data and acquire the ability to aggregate and analyze the data.
advice: In this course, you will learn the following basic knowledge as an introduction to data science. 1. Basic operations of Excel: Learn the basic operations of the spreadsheet software Excel, which is an introductory tool for handling data. 2. Aggregation/analysis of experimental data: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze experimental data. 3. Questionnaire data aggregation/analysis: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze questionnaire data. 4. Aggregation/analysis of open data: Use Excel to aggregate/analyze open data.
books: Introduction to ICT/Introduction to Data Science 2022(Kanazawa Institute of Technology)
requiredKnowledge: No prior knowledge or skills are assumed. You will use your own laptop computer to do the exercises. Be sure to bring your laptop computer, power adapter, and network cable (LAN cable) to each class.

activityGoals.body: To be able to perform basic operations in the spreadsheet software Excel.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze experimental data.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze questionnaire data.
To be able to use Excel to aggregate and analyze open data.

achievementLevels.ideal: With a deep understanding of Excel functions, you can select and respond to various data handling problems by selecting appropriate functions. Data can be collected and analyzed in an optimal way.
achievementLevels.standard: You have learned the basic operations of Excel and can use it according to your needs.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 1) ・Starting and quitting Excel, basic operations ・Table creation (Formulas, sums, units, cell widths, formatting, cell references)
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read about the names and uses of each part of the Excel window, and about basic editing operations such as copying and moving data and adding and deleting of cells and rows. After the class, review the exercises.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 2) ・Data entry and worksheets ・Insert function
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook to see what functions are available. After the class, review the exercises.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 3) ・Relative and absolute references ・Create graph ・Print tables and graphs
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook on how to display tabular data as a graph. Review the class content so far in preparation for the report.

lessons.content: Excel (Part 4) ・Operation of multiple books ・Merge printing ・Image operations (about Paint) Presentation of the 1st report
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Read the textbook to see other Excel features. After the class, review the exercises.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 1) ・Aggregation and graph creation of experimental results using Excel ・Analysis of experimental results using Excel
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Gain an understanding of the class content and exercises in advance using class materials. After class, reconfirm the class content and exercises.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 2) ・Questionnaire survey procedures and notes ・Aggregation and graphing of questionnaire surv ey results using Excel ・Analysis of questionnaire survey results using Excel
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Gain an understanding of the class content and exercises in advance using class materials. After class, reconfirm the class content and exercises.

lessons.content: Data handling skills (Part 3) ・Explanation of open data ・Aggregation and graphing of open data using Excel ・Analysis of open data using Excel Presentation of the 2nd report
lessons.operation: Lecture and exercises using laptop computer
lessons.assignments: Gain an understanding of the class content and exercises in advance using class materials. Review the previous class content and the exercises on data handling skills.
